issue.title: Page numbers in the multi-URL collection contents page (two-pass render)

task_type_fields.proposal: Show page numbers in a multi-URL collection's contents page. `web_clip_render.render_collection` (scripts/web_clip/web_clip_render.py) builds an opening page whose numbered contents entries link to `#part-N`, but Chromium has no `target-counter()`, so v1 prints links without page numbers. A two-pass render would print once, read each `part-N` destination's page index from the PDF, then re-print with the numbers injected into the contents list, keeping the page-1 Highlights marker, the one-bookmark-per-part outline, and continuous footers. The adapter has no pinned PDF parsing dependency today, so the design must choose how to read destinations (for example Chromium's own output via an extra DevTools pass, or a vendored minimal parser). Proposed by the plan of epic bob-cli-7v (out-of-scope list: "contents page numbers (two-pass render)"), recorded by the bob-cli-7v land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-7v's plan explicitly ships linked contents without page numbers in v1 and lists the two-pass render as a follow-up; it needs a PDF-reading approach the epic chose not to add.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-7v shipped collection contents with links but no page numbers because Chromium lacks target-counter(); its plan recorded the two-pass render as a follow-up.
